text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on March 7, 2019. Councillor Matlow, during the morning session of the meeting, provided Members of Council with a copy of the Toronto Seniors Strategy 2.0 and encouraged everyone to read this important document. Councillor Matlow thanked Andrea Austen, Project Lead and Dr. Samir K. Sinha, Co-Chair for their invaluable work on the Seniors Strategy.
